<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Event Overview</strong></h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Commissioners say the food distribution aims to help local residents struggling with access to groceries amid rising food prices, ongoing federal furloughs, and recent challenges related to <strong>SNAP benefits</strong>. Participants will receive one food box per family, per vehicle, while supplies last.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Commissioner <strong>Stormy Gage-Watts</strong> said the initiative reflects the Parish’s commitment to addressing local hunger needs.</p><div class="jeg_ad jeg_ad_article jnews_content_inline_2_ads  "><div class='ads-wrapper align-center '><a href='https://larrionhillman.com/' aria-label="Visit advertisement link" target="_blank" rel="nofollow noopener" class='adlink ads_image align-center'>

<blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">“We know that many families in our community are struggling right now, especially with challenges accessing SNAP benefits, the impact of federal furloughs, and the rising costs of food,” Gage-Watts said. “Providing distribution opportunities, such as the Commission’s event, is a way to offer immediate relief and ensure that no one in our parish has to face food insecurity alone.”</p>
</blockquote>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Love Shreveport-Bossier Media confirmed that the event was made possible through funding from the <strong>Caddo Parish Commission</strong> and a partnership with the <strong>Food Bank of Northwest Louisiana</strong>, which will oversee food acquisition and distribution.</p><div class='mailmunch-forms-in-post-middle' style='display: none !important;'></div>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Community Impact And Continuing Support</strong></h4>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Love Shreveport-Bossier Media confirmed that similar community outreach programs led by the Caddo Parish Commission have helped hundreds of families throughout 2025. Organizers expect strong turnout at this month’s event and are encouraging residents to arrive early.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Officials noted that all food box distributions will be handled safely through drive-thru service to reduce wait times and ensure efficient distribution. Additional community support events are being planned for the upcoming holiday season to help families in need.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Residents seeking more information about the November 22 food distribution can contact the <strong>Caddo Parish Commission Office</strong> or the <strong>Food Bank of Northwest Louisiana</strong> for details.</p>
